text:
emma-cs: Heads up — several enterprise customers in South America just escalated. 5xx spike and p95 shootup around 09:03 UTC, customer ticket #8742. sample trace: trace_0a1b2c

deploy-bot: [09:05] routing/policies v2.13 deployed (canary 20%)

olivia-support: Customers see a mix of 503 and intermittent 401s. One log: 'auth: token validation failed: key not found' — attaching service logs from acme-corp.

josh-sre: I'm pulling traces now. @ravi-rt can you check runtime routing for sa-* prefixes? suspect fallback mapping.

ravi-rt: checking. I see a recent alias mapping in /routing/region_aliases: 'sa-west' -> 'us-west-2-fallback' applied in v2.13. That would cause cross-region fallbacks.

alex-support: Repro attempt:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "X-Redwood-Region: sa-west" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Response: 503 or 401 depending on which backend picks the request. Trace id returned: trace_0a1b2c.

monitoring-bot: Alerts: api.latency.p95 > 1.8s for region tag sa-west (09:03 - 09:20 UTC), 502/503 rate up 6x.

josh-sre: Root cause hypothesis: the new alias caused routing to pick a US fallback for SA traffic. That increased RTT and produced cache K/V misses and KMS lookups in wrong region causing token_key not found -> 401 for some sessions.

olivia-support: Customers on dedicated pools saw higher error rates and billing meter misattribution (tokens billed to us-west accounts instead of sa pools) — opening billing followup.

ravi-rt: Immediate mitigation applied at 09:28 UTC: rolled back region_alias 'sa-west' entry (v2.13 -> v2.12), forced router sync, and restarted router-service on canary nodes.

deploy-bot: [09:29] routing/policies reverted to v2.12; router-service restart trigger issued.

josh-sre: After rollback we saw p95 drop to ~600ms within 12 mins; 502/503 rates falling. 401s reduced after KMS token cache rehydration.

alex-support: Repro check post-fix: same curl returns 200 and tokens validate.

emma-cs: Customer comms: initial triage note sent to affected accounts at 09:50 UTC. Offering credits for impacted windows and planning a postmortem.

ravi-rt: Root cause summary (prelim): a config change introduced an incorrect fallback mapping for SA region aliases -> US fallback. This produced cross-region routing that:
- increased latency due to cross-region RTT,
- caused cache/Vary mismatches (KV cache keys include region),
- triggered KMS key lookups in wrong region for some tokens -> intermittent 401s,
- led to billing attribution anomalies for dedicated capacity.

josh-sre: Action items (short):
- revert and verify (done)
- run full audit for region_alias changes in deploy pipeline (ravi)
- add strong pre-deploy validation for alias-to-region mappings (eng-release)
- create automated canary that checks KMS key resolution per region
- CS to coordinate credits and customer debrief (emma/olivia)

olivia-support: Customer-facing postmortem draft started. Will include repro steps, root cause, mitigation timeline, and credit plan.

emma-cs: I'll schedule a 1:1 with top impacted customers tomorrow 14:00 local SA time.

ravi-rt: Follow-ups: add unit test for region_alias parser, alert if alias resolves to region outside allowed geography for a region tag, and add a validation gate that blocks alias edits if canary fails KMS region sanity check.

josh-sre: Assigning owners: ravi -> routing validation + tests; alex-support -> reproduce and attach exact failing traces to postmortem; emma/olivia -> customer comms + credits; eng-release -> deploy pipeline gate.

monitoring-bot: Incident closed to paging at 10:15 UTC. Postmortem scheduled.

emma-cs: Thanks team. Logging this thread under incident ref SA-FALLBACK-2026-03-17 for the postmortem doc.
